title: Knowing what “done” means
capability: Task memory: a teacher-written note of the expert end state, plus a per-step goal line
summary: “Relocate it” hides the real goal (about 30 cm outward). With the note, the planner moves the deck the right distance, where it used to stop after 13 cm.
evidence: Dev A/B vs H1 (same seeds, two passes): 49.4% vs 35.1% and 47.2% vs 35.5%, +34.5 episodes per pass

title: Turning the right side to face the robot
capability: Orientation: place(face, face_now) + audited end-state note
summary: The planner says which way the QR side faces now; the tool turns it 178° to face the robot, instead of applying a guessed −90° turn.
evidence: rotate_qrcode: 0/30 dev episodes before; 0/10 → 5/10 on evaluation episodes (tool + note combined)

title: Not knocking over tall bottles
capability: Grasp parameters: fingers close horizontally on tall slender objects
summary: A tilted grasp used to close one finger above the other and tip the bottle over. Now both bottles come up upright in 4 calls.
evidence: Bench knock-overs 11 → 4; fired on 126 target pairs, 41 wins / 10 losses; H16 accepted at +5.45 pp (lower bound +2.99)

title: Letting go without throwing
capability: Execution: partial open → back off → open fully
summary: Opening the fingers fully at the table flung the card box 43 cm. The new release order keeps it within 0.5 cm of the target.
evidence: Fired on 334 target pairs, 72 wins / 37 losses; bench 49 releases, 0 worse; H16 accepted at +5.45 pp

title: Refusing a false “done”
capability: Verification: held-object height check that allows for hanging and swing
summary: The old check read the height from the gripper and accepted done while the mic hung too low. The new check says “not confirmed”, so the model lifts 4 cm more and succeeds.
evidence: Decision set 194 pairs +18.04 pp (lower bound +12.24); target cluster 45 wins / 18 losses; evaluation 63.6% vs 60.4%
